title: Casual mobile game with GenAI as a part of the game
author: a_dukhounik
selftext:
Hello there, wanted to share a game I’ve been developing with my friends: 

https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/alchemic-ai-infinity-mix/id6466730288 

And

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hostelguys.alchemicai

Please let me know what do you think :)

comments.author: questmachina
comments.body:
Cool! I downloaded and played for a bit, everything looks very polished. It's a neat idea and a great use of LLM to handle the edge cases. Some thoughts:  
\- Each generation costs some energy but it's not clear how much until you run out. Could this be labeled somewhere?  
\- After you have more than 15 recent elements, it becomes quite hard to find niche elements to add to a new mix. Could that 15 slot area be scrollable and contain everything?

replies.author: a_dukhounik
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback! Yeah we’ve been discussing these particular aspects and plan to address them soon!

comments.author: oniris
comments.body: Love it. Sometimes, the element that is quoted as being a goal has already been discovered.

replies.author: a_dukhounik
replies.body: Yup, it means you’ve gotten the element from the elements pack, not created by merging other elements. However, we should improve how we explain to the players :)

replies.author: oniris
replies.body:
Ah! Understood. :)

Lovely game, thorougly enjoying it.

replies.author: oniris
replies.body: I'm curious, besides being perhaps hard to find, and "cool"; do rares, epics and legendary have any other properties? (Higher chance to create something valuable perhaps, more versatile?)

replies.author: a_dukhounik
replies.body: For now it’s mostly being “cool”. But there are elements which have hidden meta-qualities, like Material. This is still a grey area and we are looking into it

replies.author: oniris
replies.body: Looking forward to exploring all the grey aread, always my favorite in games. Good luck, will post a good review :)

comments.author: imixxal
comments.body: Has anyone else noticed how frequently the game seems to favor the volcano element? What's your take on this?

replies.author: a_dukhounik
replies.body: this is not up to us, but to ChatGPT.. it thinks Volcano is suitable result for many combinations :)
